page_title: INT 4-4 JUV | Inter v Juventus 27/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+2' The resulting set piece from Inter is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+2' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Inter comes to nothing. Inter get a corner.
90+1' A pass lands at the feet of Davide Frattesi (Inter) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. Inter earn a corner.
90' A yellow card for bad language! Juan Cabal (Juventus) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
90' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
90' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
87' The substitution is prepared. Mehdi Taremi (Inter) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Marcus Thuram.
85' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Marco Guida signals.
83' Thiago Motta has decided to substitute Weston McKennie and he is replaced by Khephren Thuram (Juventus).

82' 4 - 4 Goal! Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. Yann Sommer is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 4:4.
81' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
77' Substitution. Matteo Darmian (Inter) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Federico Dimarco walks off.
77' Here is a change. Dusan Vlahovic is going off and Thiago Motta gives the last tactical orders to Samuel Mbangula (Juventus).
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Danilo trots off the pitch and is replaced by Federico Gatti (Juventus).
76' Marcus Thuram slides a brilliant pass into Lautaro Martinez (Inter), but his shot from inside the box goes a whisker over the crossbar.
75' Marco Guida shows a yellow card to Denzel Dumfries (Inter) for his blatant foul.
75' Federico Dimarco (Inter) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
74' Federico Dimarco (Inter) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Inter can continue in their attacking effort.
71' 4 - 3 Goal! Weston McKennie plays a long ball to Kenan Yildiz (Juventus), who cuts inside and unleashes a screamer into the bottom right corner. The keeper had no chance. Superb strike! 4:3.
70' The corner is sent into the box by Federico Dimarco, but Lautaro Martinez (Inter) flashes the ball a whisker past the right post.
70' Federico Dimarco (Inter) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
69' The referee awards a corner and Federico Dimarco (Inter) goes over to take it.
69' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball goes out of play. Inter are awarded a corner kick.
69' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
68' Nicolo Barella (Inter) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
66' The resulting corner from Federico Dimarco (Inter) is cleared by the defence.
66' Inter have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

65' Michele Di Gregorio blocks a long-range effort from Federico Dimarco (Inter) towards the right side of the goal. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Inter.
65' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
64' Juan Cabal (Juventus) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
63' Simone Inzaghi prepares a substitution. Benjamin Pavard is replaced by Yann Bisseck (Inter).
63' We are about to witness a subsitution. Davide Frattesi (Inter) for Piotr Zielinski.
62' Substitution. Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) on for Timothy Weah.
61' Thiago Motta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nicolo Savona (Juventus) replacing Nicolo Fagioli.
61' The resulting corner, taken by Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus), comes to nothing.
61' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) works the corner short.

60' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Juventus.
59' Benjamin Pavard (Inter) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Guida had an easy-decision to make.
58' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
58' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Weston McKennie (Juventus). Juventus have a corner.
58' Weston McKennie latches onto a perfect defence-splitting pass from Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) and heads towards goal.
53' 4 - 2 Goal! Denzel Dumfries (Inter) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 4:2.
53' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) will take the corner.

53' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Inter have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
52' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Danilo (Juventus) was quite harsh and Marco Guida didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
51' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the corner but it's cleared.
50' Inter have been awarded a corner kick. Lautaro Martinez (Inter) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.

50' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Federico Dimarco (Inter) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Michele Di Gregorio pulls off a brilliant save.
50' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) releases Federico Dimarco, who latched on to his perfect through pass and can continue with his team's attack.
49' Danilo (Juventus) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Marco Guida has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
49' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
48' Nicolo Barella (Inter) sends a long ball forward to Federico Dimarco, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
47' Juventus seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Timothy Weah (Juventus) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post.
45+2' A crossfield pass from Federico Dimarco (Inter) fails to find any of his teammates.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Yann Sommer, who smothers the ball.
43' Federico Dimarco (Inter) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
42' Marcus Thuram (Inter) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
42' Marco Guida has a clear sight and sees a foul from Denzel Dumfries (Inter).
39' Federico Dimarco (Inter) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
37' 3 - 2 Goal! Piotr Zielinski (Inter) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Michele Di Gregorio.
37' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

36' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Marco Guida no option but to blow his whistle. Penalty awarded! Inter will take a penalty kick.

35' 2 - 2 Marcus Thuram is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot into the bottom left corner to make the score 2:2.
33' Juventus can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
32' Great save! Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the right side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Yann Sommer.
32' The foul by Denzel Dumfries (Inter) was seen by Marco Guida who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
30' Nicolo Barella (Inter) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
30' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
28' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
26' 1 - 2 Goal! Francisco Conceicao puts the ball on a plate for Timothy Weah (Juventus), who scores with a simple close-range finish. It's 1:2.
25' Marco Guida blows his whistle. Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) commits a foul after dangerous play.
24' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
22' Federico Dimarco (Inter) will deliver the corner kick.
22' Federico Dimarco (Inter) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The referee points to the corner flag and Inter will take a corner.
20' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Weston McKennie picks out Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) with a sweet pass, and he latches on to it deep inside the box and beats the goalkeeper. 1:1.
18' Marco Guida blows his whistle as Timothy Weah (Juventus) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
15' 1 - 0 Goal! Piotr Zielinski (Inter) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Michele Di Gregorio into middle of the goal.
15' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) is going to take the penalty!

14' Danilo (Juventus) brings his opponent down. Marco Guida has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. The referee gives a penalty to Inter after a quick talk with the linesman, who had apparently seen the situation from a better perspective.
13' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Marco Guida who sees an offensive foul.
10' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Federico Dimarco (Inter).
10' Nicolo Barella (Inter) sprays a pass out to Lautaro Martinez, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball. Inter win a corner.
9' A cross from Benjamin Pavard (Inter) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
9' Rough tackle by Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
8' A long pass, executed by Manuel Locatelli (Juventus), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
7' Federico Dimarco (Inter) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
6' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
6' The Inter players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
4' Danilo (Juventus) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
4' Danilo (Juventus) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
3' Danilo (Juventus) jumps into a tackle and Marco Guida signals a foul.
2' The corner is swung in but Juventus can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
2' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play. Juventus win a corner kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Juventus will have the kick-off.
Marco Guida will officiate today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
